messages:
lin: FYI I ran a focused regression check for rwd-v3.1-quant4 on the long-concat summarization slice. results are noisy but there's a consistent small drift in extractive scores for citations.
tara: how big is the drift? any sign it's due to tokenization or attention sparsity in quant4?
lin: on 3k paired samples, extractive F1 down ~0.9% (bootstrap 95% CI [-1.5%, -0.3%]). abstractive ROUGE-L flat. delta concentrated near citation boundaries where the model truncates the citation label tokens.
aj: pair-wise routing used? paired analysis helps reduce session variance. also we should check token-level argmax stability.
sasha: we did paired quiet-shadow for the run. token-level argmax flips are up ~1.4% on affected positions. looks like quantization changes the relative logits for near-ties.
lin: proposal: introduce a two-stage gate for this onboard: (1) prefill/warmup of KV for long-concat slice with 2k requests, require kv_hit_rate >= 60%; (2) paired quiet-shadow 15% for 2h; then (3) soft-canary 2% for 1h. automatic promote allowed only if composite_quality_pass and no hard error bursts.
tara: what is composite_quality_pass? define metrics and thresholds.
lin: composite = (a) extractive_F1_delta >= -0.7% (paired), (b) token_argmax_flip_rate <= +1.0% absolute, (c) rougeL_delta >= -0.5, (d) no error-rate spike > 0.3%. all must pass. if any metric fails but is within a soft-fail window (e.g., extractive_F1_delta between -0.7% and -1.2%), require manual review.
aj: add stability requirement: metric breach must persist for 2 consecutive 10m windows to trigger auto-fallback. also require raw logits capture for 2k paired samples for debugging.
sasha: ops: note that quant4 variant shows occasional batching jitter on hosts with mixed small/large batches. add host-level p99-latency delta <= +80ms and p99_gpu_mem_delta <= +5% as gates.
lin: good call. I'll add that to the rollout policy. also suggest an automated remediation: if token-argmax flips appear concentrated in specific token ids, we can run a fast "softfix" that adds a small post-logit bias for those ids in the quant variant while we investigate. manual approval required to enable softfix.
tara: how do we signal high-importance slices? we should maintain a config list so global promotes can veto if a high-importance slice fails.
lin: yes, we'll mark long-concat as high-importance. gating will be evaluated per-slice and globally (global pass requires aggregate quality delta >= -0.4% and no high-importance slice failing).
rollout-bot: saved rollout policy: {"variant":"rwd-v3.1-quant4","warmup_requests":"2000","quiet_shadow_pct":"15","quiet_shadow_window":"2h","soft_canary_pct":"2","soft_canary_window":"1h","composite_quality":"extractiveF1>=-0.7%,token_flip<=1.0%,rougeL>=-0.5%,err_rate<=0.3%","host_gates":"p99_lat_delta<=80ms,p99_gpu_mem_delta<=5%","stability":"2x10m","high_importance_slices":["long-concat"]} (use /rollout edit to change)
lin: i'll run the warmup job tonight and post the paired-shadow snapshot in the morning. thanks y'all :raised_hands:
